requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Provide ID, home info, landlord approval if renting, and vet references.
items: Proof of residence and housing stability
Landlord approval if renting (pet policy documentation)
Veterinary references for current or previous pets
All household members must meet the dog
Commitment to provide lifelong care and love
